verdict.rationale: Summer documents that agents can read a game's analytics through its MCP server so the user can learn from players and improve the game. That is a product-provided path to AI-driven insight from the user's own data. However, the analysis is done by whatever agent is connected, and nothing shows Summer itself generating insights or suggestions in its own interface. missing for 10: first-party in-product AI insight or suggestion generation, documentation of what analytics data is exposed and what insights result, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can get AI-generated insights and suggestions from my data inside the product

citations.quote: Any agent can read your game's analytics through the MCP, so you learn from players and make the game better.
Watch how people play, set your price, and plan the next update.
